issue.title: Error introduced in HttpMessageDecoder

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
I believe that commit 78301f4a introduced an error into the way HttpMessageDecoder handles chunked content.

It now produced chunks no larger than:

readLimit = actualReadableBytes()

If there is a premature connection closure (before all bytes have been read), then the frame decoder calls cleanup which calls decode followed by decodeLast.

With this commit calling decode from cleanup will produce a chunk that contains all of the bytes in the buffer. The subsequent call to decodeLast will pass an empty buffer into HttpMessageDecoder. Even if there are more bytes that SHOULD be read (i.e. we haven't received the entire content yet), we will create a HttpChunk with readLimit set to 0. This will produce a trailing chunk.

Previously, we would see no trailing chunk before the channel closed message and be able to detect premature termination.

If this is indeed an error, I believe it needs to be addressed with a 3.5.2 release.
